text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 5, "unit": "baskets", "kind": "count", "span": "Katherine has 5 hanging baskets to fill"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 3, "unit": "petunias", "kind": "count", "span": "in each basket she wants to add 3 petunias"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "vines", "kind": "count", "span": "2 sweet potato vines"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 3.0, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "the petunias cost $3.00 apiece"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 2.5, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "the sweet potato vines cost $2.50 apiece"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "q4"], "out": "s1", "note": "cost of the petunias in one basket"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q3", "q5"], "out": "s2", "note": "cost of the sweet potato vines in one basket"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "cost of filling one basket"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s3", "q1"], "out": "s4", "note": "cost of filling all five baskets"}], "target": {"kind": "money", "scope": "the total amount Katherine will spend filling all 5 hanging baskets"}, "dismissed": []}
